events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today, known for her distinctive voice and influential rock career.

angles.name: Punk Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her raw energy and iconic tracks with The Pretenders shaped a generation. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday, a distinctive voice in British rock music.

angles.name: Rock'n'Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still got that swagger. What's your top track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was first issued as a single in the UK in 1975 to promote his compilation album 'Shaved Fish'.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: 41 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity remains as powerful today as it was in 1975.

events.title: The first Apple iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how music was consumed by putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed the game, putting a thousand songs in your pocket. How many did you own?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's enduring legacy. What's your all-time favourite Bond theme tune or iconic gadget?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From silly walks to classic comedy, he's a true national treasure.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that pushed boundaries. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died at the age of 45.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true icon. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: A Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showcased their lyrical maturity and musical adventurousness. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot outside his New York City residence at the age of 40.

angles.name: Forever Missed
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace resonate louder than ever. We remember a true legend.
